title: Tomb in Siberia reveals humans were using cannabis 2800 years ago | New Scientist
description: Psychoactive compounds have been found in a hair from a Scythian tomb in Siberia, providing the earliest direct evidence of cannabis being used as a drug
author: Chris Simms

title: The economic benefits of the covid vaccines may be double what we thought | New Scientist
description: The global health and economic benefits of the covid-19 vaccines were thought to have reached up to $38 trillion in their first year, but a new analysis suggests $64.3 trillion is a more accurate figure
author: Shosha Adie

title: Evidence of active volcanoes on Mars may boost chances of finding life | New Scientist
description: Recent fractures on the surface of Mars and gases detected by an orbiter probe provide some of the strongest evidence yet that the planet is volcanically active
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Microplastics may be changing the colour of the Pacific Ocean | New Scientist
description: Satellites show that the ocean around a gyre of plastic detritus in the Pacific is brightening and changing colour, with the most likely explanation being microplastics suspended in the water column
author: James Woodford

title: Marginal oil and gas wells have outsized pollution impact | New Scientist
description: Low-producing oil and gas wells in the US account for 5 per cent of national oil and gas production but produce 40 per cent of the industry's methane emissions
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Stunning collection of prehistoric engravings found in Spanish cave | New Scientist
description: A close examination of a frequently visited cave wall in Spain has revealed a spectacular assembly of rock art engravings thought to be at least 19,000 years old
author: James Woodford
